purpose: Teach: 瞬時/歳入/排気/後記/稼げる/頂けれ/興行/続出

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、瞬時の判断で、被害を、最小限にしました。
lines.en: Our officers made the right call in those first seconds. We contained the damage.
lines.style: Professional, measured. Quiet pride without boasting. Each phrase carries deliberate weight. Steady eye contact — this is the fact of what happened.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域防犯予算、自治体歳入から、配分されていますね。
lines.en: Right. That funding comes from the municipal budget for community safety programs.
lines.style: Attentive, engaged. Leaning in slightly — showing he's tracking the details. Respectful but not stiff. The rhythm of someone taking notes internally.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、排気のにおい、捜査の手がかりになりました。
lines.en: The suspect's vehicle left traces at the scene — exhaust patterns actually became a key lead.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, technical. No drama. Speaking to the precision of procedure. Even tone, steady cadence. The small details that solve cases.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察広報の後記、ご担当者様、入念に書かれていますね。
lines.en: I noticed you were thorough with that final statement in the press release — it covered a lot of ground.
lines.style: Appreciative, slightly curious. Gentle acknowledgment of care taken. Warm but genuinely observant — he's actually read it carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 詐欺事件、簡単に稼げる話、警戒してください。
lines.en: These fraud schemes prey on people looking for quick money. I'd urge real caution with anything that sounds too easy.
lines.style: Shift to firmer — this matters. Quiet conviction on the warning. Not lecturing, protecting. Slower pace. The accumulated weight of cases he's seen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ご助言を頂ければ、社内研修に、活かします。
lines.en: We'll take that to heart. Information like this actually shapes our internal training.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude underneath. Professional but not distant. He means it — this isn't protocol, it's real preparation. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 大規模興行、警備、特別態勢で、臨みます。
lines.en: For the big events coming up, we're deploying enhanced security teams across the board.
lines.style: Assured, organized. Speaking with the weight of logistics behind it. No anxiety — just readiness. Clear, steady delivery of a plan in motion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害相談、続出している、世相ですよね、最近。
lines.en: It's been a difficult season for that kind of thing. The calls keep coming in.
lines.style: Quiet shared concern. A small sigh underneath — exhaustion of witnessing this pattern. Not dark, just real. Closing with a sense of ongoing work.
